note: RunPod endpoints for the new worker (worker/endpoints.py saves them; saveEndpoint is a full replace). Secrets are RunPod secret references, never values.

sm-image.note: Retired 19 Nov (plan 3f): every workflow runs on its one-model endpoint (sm-krea2, sm-qwen, sm-zimage). Kept at 0 workers for a week as the rollback.

sm-live.note: Retired 19 Nov (plan 3f, owner: no warm dwell). Kept at 0 workers for a week as the rollback.

sm-zimage.note: One model per endpoint (18 Nov): a worker FlashBoot resumes always has Z-Image loaded; no idle dwell. --disable-dynamic-vram so a resumed worker still holds the weights in GPU memory (DynamicVRAM re-reads them); SM_PREFETCH reads the weights into RAM while ComfyUI boots. RTX 5090 first (18 Nov probe: resumed 13 s with the model still loaded, cold 38 s, half the PRO 6000's price; PRO 6000 hosts were throttled most of the evening).

sm-krea2.note: One model per endpoint (plan step 3f, 19 Nov): Krea 2 Turbo fp8 (krea2-turbo.json), 18.6 GB bundle. PRO 6000 first: the 19 Nov probe ran 22-25 s a picture warm on the RTX 5090 (the same model family runs ~10 s on the PRO 6000). No dwell; FlashBoot; flags as sm-zimage.

sm-qwen.note: One model per endpoint (plan step 3f, 19 Nov): Qwen-Image 2.1 bf16 + Turbo LoRA + Qwen3-VL 8B (qwen21, qwen21-turbo, qwen21-edit, qwen21-combine), 33.4 GB bundle; 80 GB-class GPUs (weights stay resident). No dwell; FlashBoot; flags as sm-zimage.

sm-video.note: Video (plan step 6, 19 Nov): MiniMax H3 FL2VA, h3-i2v.json and h3-fl2v.json; 5 s at 1344x768, 24 fps, with sound; ~100 s a clip on a PRO 6000. One model, no dwell; flags as sm-zimage. Max 1 (account quota 10).
